=======================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Purnendu Singh
Oral Order

2 27-02-2026 Heard Mr. Ranjan Kumar Dubey along with Mr. Kumar Gaurav, Mr. Sheshadri Kumari and Mr.
Shashank Kashyap, learned counsels for the petitioner; Mr. Gyan Shankar along with Ms. Ankita Basdeo Chaudhary vs The State Of Bihar on 27 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150845165/
1

Roy, learned counsels for the Sugar Patna High Court CWJC No.2782 of 2026(2) dt.27-02-2026 Corporation; Ms. Vagisha Pragya, learned counsel for the BIADA and Mr. Amit Bhushan, learned AC to GP 17 for the State.

2. The petitioner in paragraph no. 1 of the present writ petition has sought inter alia following relief(s), which is repro- duced hereinafter:-
"(i) For issuance of a writ in the na- ture of Mandamus directing the respondents to produce records of so called land acquisition case, in which land of petitioner has been ac- quired and if not so then they may be directed to initiate land acquisition proceeding under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Reset- tlement Act, 2013 for acquisition of the dis- puted land and and to pay adequate compen- sation to petitioners for their raiyati lands bearing Tauzi No. 3296, Thana No.
1060, Khata No. 135/174, Plot No. 332, having its area 9 Katha 7 Dhur, situated at Mauza Badarjimi, Anchal Hathua, for which Jama- bandi No. 202 running in the name of the peti- tioner.

(ii) For issuance of writ in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondents, partic- ularly respondents second set, to not take forceful possession, or making any type of con- struction over the raiyati/purchased land of pe- titioner bearing Tauzi No. 3296, Thana No. 1060, Khata No.
135/174, Plot No. 332, having its area 9 Katha 7 Dhurs, situated at Mauza Badarjimi, Anchal Hathua, for which Jama- bandi No. 202 is running in the name of the pe- titioner.

(iii) For any other writ/writs, order/orders for which petitioners deem enti- tled to"
Patna High Court CWJC No.2782 of 2026(2) dt.27-02-2026 3.

Considering the reliefs as prayed for in the present writ petition, as well as, the pleadings supported by the documents brought on record, the petitioner claims title and ownership over the land appertaining to Tauzi No. 3296, Thana No. 1060, Khata No. 135/174, Plot No. 332, total area measuring 9 Kathas and 7 Dhurs, situated at Mauza Badarjim, Anchal Hathua, Jamabandi No.
202.
4.

From the averments made in the writ petition, it can not be ascertained, as to, when the aforesaid land was acquired by the State Government for S.K. Distillery, which has subsequently gone in the possession of BIADA pursuant to a lawful order of transfer by the State Government.
It further appears from paragraph No. 13 of the writ petition that the land has allegedly been mutated in favour of BIADA without reference to any supporting acquisition records.
5. In such circumstances, the petitioner, if so advised, may avail appropriate remedy before the District Magistrate- cum-Collector, Gopalganj.

6. The District Magistrate-cum-Collector, Gopalganj, is directed to call for the relevant revenue records and the concerned revenue officer in respect of the land as described in the writ petition to Basdeo Chaudhary vs The State Of Bihar on 27 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150845165/
2 verify, whether any acquisition proceeding Patna High Court CWJC No.2782 of 2026(2)
dt.27-02-2026 was initiated in respect of the piece of land, which the petitioner claims belong to him and he is entitled for compensation.
7.
